answer: Each seat is bound to one registered GNSS monument and a 180 POA bond. Eight seconds before a 20-second window, three beacons (sparrow, raven, and a control sited on karst) demand an IQ snapshot of a GPS or Galileo SV chosen as H(epoch-seed || pubkey || t). Site multipath and antenna phase-center form a fingerprint; two keys whose residuals agree within 3 cm or 0.2 cycle collapse to one seat and forfeit 90 POA, so a farm of labels on one roof buys no extra weight. Raw snapshots stay public for four epochs so peers can replay the merge; leftover collateral refunds after three sealed answers.
